label: God’s suppositum is his nature: For a being g satisfying the original IsGod predicate…
definition: For a being g satisfying the original IsGod predicate, suppositumOf g = essenceOf g in the existing Principle sort. This represents q.3 a.3’s absence of a real suppositum/nature distinction for God. It is an explicit universal open commitment, not a definition of IsGod or a theorem inferred from generic simplicity. It does not equate Lean objects in Being with objects in Principle.
note: This record explains vocabulary used by the explicit proposition STMT-Q11-GOD-SUPPOSITUM-IS-NATURE. The linked GodSuppositumIsNatureReading is that OPEN universal constraint over the independently supplied IsGod, suppositumOf and essenceOf parameters, not a definition making the equality hold. Its scope and acceptance are carried by the statement/argument records, not established by this glossary record.
